_comment: GIN device-API benchmark matrix for run-device-api-ci.sh.
Add a mode by appending a suites entry. Each suite runs every bin as:
RCCL_TESTS_BIN_DIR is the absolute cmake build dir (.ci-out/rccl-tests-build
for this job). The non-GIN symmetric matrix is device-api-nongin-tests.json,
After the matrix, run-device-api-ci.sh runs pytest test/test_AllToAllDevtime.py
bench_args: common bench flags | base_env: -x on every run
{LOGDIR} in debug_env is replaced by the runner with the per-job debug dir,
so NCCL_DEBUG_FILE writes per-rank logs there instead of flooding stdout.
Switched from YAML to JSON because PyYAML is not installed on the CI hosts.
